macos.notes: The production adapter is exercised over a real full-host AppKit NSView and deterministic consumer renderer. Storage, clip, presentation, input gate, resize, collapse, stale evidence, destruction, and reversible detach pass. The available host did not expose a distinct live scale transition; that claim remains unmet and unsimulated.

windows.notes: No Windows backing-storage runtime or packaged proof exists. The product-free Rust adapter remains portable, but native storage and renderer integration are consumer work.

linux.notes: No Linux backing-storage runtime or packaged proof exists. The product-free Rust adapter remains portable, but native storage and renderer integration are consumer work.
